title: Remnants in Depth — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Remnants in Depth's rich face: two walks that test the page's claims on BLUELINE's own mark, street and billboard rig (the card against the metaball, the white square and its two fixes), the blob field and the flow-field proof gathered beside the sections they serve, and the findings held as offers for Loudon. I grow when the page is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.file: Remnants in Depth — rich — flat and in depth.html
pieces.title: flat and in depth · five steps
pieces.caption: **Which one stays ink?** One BLUELINE synth mark, rendered in Blender 5.1.2: on paper, on cards at two depths under a sideways camera move (each slides f·Δx⁄z, to within 0.1 px), a card that stays put against one that faces the camera, the same mark built as a metaball, and last all three orbited from 0 to 90 degrees and held against the drawn mark. The facing card agrees at 1.000 at every angle; the metaball falls to 0.839 at 30° and 0.631 at 90°, its satellites gone behind the body by 70°.

pieces.title: the blob field · BLUELINE
pieces.caption: The three steps run end to end: synthesised marks placed by blob_swarm.py as camera-facing billboards through a depth shell around the Freestyle street, a strike cluster and a few big foreground masses, each with its pop-in and fade. The camera trucks; near marks sweep, far ones barely drift. 30 frames at 15 fps, Blender only. BLUELINE, 2026-06-25.

pieces.file: Remnants in Depth — rich — the white square.html
pieces.by: Blender (headless) · blob_swarm.py's street, line style and compositor
pieces.title: the white square · five steps
pieces.caption: **Which fix carries the weight?** BLUELINE's street with two billboards, rendered in Blender 5.1.2 with blob_swarm.py's own rig: the lines alone, the white square in one view layer (1.6 % of the line survives in the billboard's empty corners), DITHERED alone (pixel for pixel the same square), two view layers alone, and the test. With the material as the script writes it, the two layers alone are clean, BLENDED or DITHERED: no edge pixel moves more than 4 of 255. A faint edge (8 pixels, at most 8 of 255) shows only with the material's texture clip and hard alpha both undone.

pieces.title: random against flow-biased · BLUELINE
pieces.near: so strong-field marks streak with the motion
pieces.caption: Left, the random scatter (blob_swarm.py's baseline); right, flowfield_spatter.py's pass, marks placed by the field's strength, stretched up to 3.6 times along it and rolled to its direction. The flow pass also makes marks bigger where the field is strong, so ink goes from 8.0 % of the frame to 16.4 %: density, size and direction change together here. BLUELINE, 2026-06-25.

offers.what: "Neither fix alone is enough" did not reproduce on Blender 5.1.2 with blob_swarm.py's material as it stands. Two view layers alone (material BLENDED) keep every line (4807 of 4807 in the billboard's empty corners; 0 lost in the frame) and leave no plane edge (0 of 2913 edge-ring pixels move more than 4/255; largest change 0). DITHERED alone changes nothing (one layer, BLENDED and DITHERED renders identical, 1.6 % of the line kept). The material already guards the edge twice: CLIP extension (the script's comment: 'kills the square frame') and the alpha cut at 0.45; undo both and a faint edge appears (8 px, at most 8/255), undo either one and none passes 4/255. The June BLENDED edge may have come from a material before those guards; this can't be checked. Suggest: 'Two view layers are the fix. Inside the blob layer, clip the texture at its border and cut its alpha hard (or use DITHERED, which discards it) so the square's own edge can't show.'

"A body whose raggedness is driven by the measured circularity" and "the analysis sets the knobs": blob_synth.py reads the circularity (CIRC, CIRC_LO) and uses it only in its closing print. Run against two opposite signatures (circularity mean 0.99 and 0.30), it writes the same 30 blobs byte for byte (sha256 1eff2897f4f6a4df); raggedness is hand-set (32 % spiky, ragged 0.7-1.25, else 0.12-0.4). The measured diameters do reach blob_swarm.py (p10, p50, p90 set the sizes). Suggest: 'the analysis sets the sizes; the synth's raggedness is set by hand, near the measured character, and wiring circularity in is still to do'. Aside: the stored signature has circularity up to 1.40 and solidity up to 1.64, both impossible for a true shape (each is at most 1), a sign that pixel-count area over contour perimeter misreads 7-px marks.

The claim holds, measured. A camera-facing card agrees with the drawn mark at 1.000 at every orbit angle; a metaball fitted to the same mark agrees 0.839 at 30 degrees and 0.631 at 90, and its six pieces of ink become one by 70 degrees, the satellites slid behind the body. A detail the page could add: the metaball loses the mark even in flat unlit ink (its silhouette changes); 'looks like a ball' is what lighting adds on top. And COPY_ROTATION keeps the card parallel to the film, so the mark projects unchanged anywhere in frame, not only at its centre.
